title: VERY HARD to get the container off to fill.
text: VERY HARD to get the container off to fill.. I curse this thing every time I use it. My husband is a design engineer, I thought it was me but he says no, its a bad design. You have to STAND on the buttons to get it to release. If the button itself was HIGHER than you have to push it would be easier. DO NOT PURCHASE FOR AN OLDER person.. they'd never be able to do it.
